```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(corrplot)
library(dendextend)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)
library(gridExtra)
library(viridis)
library(mice)
 

# DATA PREPARATION
 
raw <- read.csv(
  '.../file.csv',
  sep = ";",
  header = TRUE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  encoding = "UTF-8",
  check.names = FALSE
)
 
meta <- read.csv(
  '.../metadata.csv',
  sep = ";",
  header = TRUE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  encoding = "UTF-8"
)
 
colnames(meta) <- c("Question", "Direction", "Principle")
meta$Q_ID <- paste0("Q", 1:32)
 

# PRELIM INFO

short_map <- c(
  "Respect for Human Agency"                       = "Human Agency",
  "Privacy and Data Governance"                    = "Privacy & Data Gov.",
  "Fairness"                                       = "Fairness",
  "Individual, Social & Environmental well-being"  = "Well-Being",
  "Transparency"                                   = "Transparency",
  "Accountability & Oversight"                     = "Accountability",
  "Worker Dignity & Equity"                        = "Worker Dignity",
  "Human Resilience Through Continuous Learning"   = "Human Resilience"
)

job_short_map <- c(
  "B2B Communication & Marketing"                  = "B2B Comms",
  "CEO"                                            = "CEO",
  "Engineer"                                       = "Engineer",
  "Director of Mobile and Collaborative Robotics"  = "Mobile Robotics Dir.",
  "R&D Director"                                   = "R&D Director",
  "Co-Founder & COO"                               = "Co-Founder/COO",
  "Robotics Researcher"                            = "Robotics Researcher",
  "Sales"                                          = "Sales",
  "Project manager"                                = "Project Manager",
  "Project Manager"                                = "Project Manager",
  "R&D Technician"                                 = "R&D Technician"
)
 
job_titles <- raw[[1]]
for (i in seq_along(job_titles)) {
  cat(sprintf("  R%02d: %s\n", i, job_titles[i]))
}
 
for (p in unique(meta$Principle)) {
  n_q    <- sum(meta$Principle == p)
  n_fwd  <- sum(meta$Principle == p & meta$Direction == "Forward")
  n_rev  <- sum(meta$Principle == p & meta$Direction == "Reverse")
}
 
# RAW LIKERT DATA

likert_raw <- raw[, 2:33]
colnames(likert_raw) <- paste0("Q", 1:32)
likert_raw <- as.data.frame(lapply(likert_raw, as.numeric))
 

# DESCRIPTIVE STATISTICS
 
likert_raw_na <- as.data.frame(lapply(likert_raw, function(x) {
  x[x == 7] <- NA
  x
}))
 
idk_counts <- colSums(likert_raw == 7, na.rm = TRUE)
print(idk_counts)

raw_desc <- data.frame(
  Q_ID      = meta$Q_ID,
  Principle = meta$Principle,
  Direction = meta$Direction,
  Mean      = round(sapply(likert_raw_na, mean,   na.rm = TRUE), 2),
  Median    = round(sapply(likert_raw_na, median, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
  SD        = round(sapply(likert_raw_na, sd,     na.rm = TRUE), 2),
  Variance  = round(sapply(likert_raw_na, var,    na.rm = TRUE), 2),
  Min       = sapply(likert_raw_na, min, na.rm = TRUE),
  Max       = sapply(likert_raw_na, max, na.rm = TRUE),
  N_missing = colSums(is.na(likert_raw_na))
)
 
print(raw_desc)
write.csv(raw_desc, "descriptive_stats_raw_per_question.csv", row.names = FALSE)
 

all_raw_values <- unlist(likert_raw_na)
all_raw_values <- all_raw_values[!is.na(all_raw_values)]

likert_raw_long <- reshape2::melt(
  cbind(likert_raw_na, Respondent = 1:nrow(likert_raw_na)),
  id.vars = "Respondent",
  variable.name = "Question",
  value.name = "Score"
)
 
p_raw_box <- ggplot(likert_raw_long, aes(x = Question, y = Score)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.6, outlier.size = 1.5) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(1, 6), breaks = 1:6) +
  labs(
    title    = "Distribution of Raw Scores per Question",
    subtitle = "Scale 1-6, 'I don't know' responses excluded, before reverse coding",
    x        = "Question",
    y        = "Raw Score"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x  = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, size = 7),
    plot.title   = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
 
ggsave("plot_raw_score_distributions.png", p_raw_box, width = 14, height = 5, dpi = 150)

# DATA PREPARATION, RECODING AND IMPUTATION

likert_clean <- as.data.frame(lapply(likert_raw, function(x) {
  x[x == 7] <- NA
  x
}))
 
scale_max     <- 6
reverse_items <- meta$Q_ID[meta$Direction == "Reverse"]

likert_recoded <- likert_clean
for (q in reverse_items) {
  likert_recoded[[q]] <- (scale_max + 1) - likert_clean[[q]]
}

mice_imputed <- mice(
  likert_recoded,
  m         = 5,
  method    = "pmm",
  seed      = 42,
  printFlag = FALSE
)

likert_recoded <- complete(mice_imputed, 1)
 

# DESCRIPTIVE STATISTICS WITH RECODED DATA
 
recoded_desc <- data.frame(
  Q_ID      = meta$Q_ID,
  Principle = meta$Principle,
  Direction = meta$Direction,
  Mean      = round(sapply(likert_recoded, mean,   na.rm = TRUE), 2),
  Median    = round(sapply(likert_recoded, median, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
  SD        = round(sapply(likert_recoded, sd,     na.rm = TRUE), 2),
  Variance  = round(sapply(likert_recoded, var,    na.rm = TRUE), 2),
  Min       = sapply(likert_recoded, min, na.rm = TRUE),
  Max       = sapply(likert_recoded, max, na.rm = TRUE)
)
 
print(recoded_desc)
write.csv(recoded_desc, "descriptive_stats_recoded_per_question.csv", row.names = FALSE)
 
principles <- unique(meta$Principle)
 
principle_scores <- data.frame(matrix(
  NA, nrow = nrow(likert_recoded), ncol = length(principles)
))
colnames(principle_scores) <- principles
 
for (p in principles) {
  cols <- meta$Q_ID[meta$Principle == p]
  principle_scores[[p]] <- rowMeans(likert_recoded[, cols], na.rm = TRUE)
}
 
principle_summary <- data.frame(
  Principle = principles,
  Mean      = round(colMeans(principle_scores, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
  Median    = round(apply(principle_scores, 2, median, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
  SD        = round(apply(principle_scores, 2, sd,     na.rm = TRUE), 2),
  Variance  = round(apply(principle_scores, 2, var,    na.rm = TRUE), 2)
)
 
print(principle_summary)
write.csv(principle_summary, "descriptive_stats_recoded_per_principle.csv", row.names = FALSE)
 
scale_midpoint <- 3.5
 
wilcox_results <- data.frame(
  Principle   = principles,
  Mean        = round(colMeans(principle_scores), 2),
  Median      = round(apply(principle_scores, 2, median), 2),
  SD          = round(apply(principle_scores, 2, sd), 2),
  W           = NA,
  p_value     = NA
)
 
for (i in seq_along(principles)) {
  test <- wilcox.test(
    principle_scores[[principles[i]]],
    mu          = scale_midpoint,
    alternative = "two.sided",
    exact       = FALSE
  )
  wilcox_results$W[i]           <- test$statistic
  wilcox_results$p_value[i]     <- round(test$p.value, 3)
}
 
print(wilcox_results)
 
# VISUALISATIONS FOR DESCRIPTIVE STATISTICS

principle_summary$Short <- c(
  "Human\nAgency",
  "Privacy &\nData Gov.",
  "Fairness",
  "Well-\nBeing",
  "Trans-\nparency",
  "Accountability\n& Oversight",
  "Worker\nDignity",
  "Human\nResilience"
)
 
p_bar <- ggplot(principle_summary, aes(x = reorder(Short, Mean), y = Mean, fill = Mean)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Mean - SD, ymax = Mean + SD), width = 0.25, color = "grey30") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 3.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", linewidth = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "plasma", direction = -1, limits = c(1, 6)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 6), breaks = 1:6) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title    = "Mean Ethical Principle Score Across Respondents",
    subtitle = "Error bars: +/- 1 SD, Dashed line: scale midpoint (3.5), Scale: 1-6",
    x        = NULL,
    y        = "Mean Score (recoded)",
    fill     = "Score"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(legend.position = "right", plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
 
ggsave("plot_principle_means.png", p_bar, width = 9, height = 5, dpi = 150)
print(p_bar)
 
ps_long            <- principle_scores
ps_long$Respondent <- paste0("R", 1:nrow(ps_long), ": ", job_titles)
ps_melt            <- melt(ps_long, id.vars = "Respondent",
                           variable.name = "Principle", value.name = "Score")
 
p_heat <- ggplot(ps_melt, aes(x = Principle, y = Respondent, fill = Score)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(Score, 1)), size = 3, color = "white", fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "plasma", direction = -1, limits = c(1, 6)) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c(
    "Respect for Human Agency"                       = "Agency",
    "Privacy and Data Governance"                    = "Privacy",
    "Fairness"                                       = "Fairness",
    "Individual, Social & Environmental well-being"  = "Well-Being",
    "Transparency"                                   = "Transparency",
    "Accountability & Oversight"                     = "Accountability",
    "Worker Dignity & Equity"                        = "Worker Dignity",
    "Human Resilience Through Continuous Learning"   = "Resilience"
  )) +
  labs(
    title    = "Respondent and Principle Score Heatmap",
    x        = "Ethical Principle",
    y        = "Respondent",
    fill     = "Score"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1),
    plot.title  = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid  = element_blank()
  )
 
ggsave("plot_respondent_principle_heatmap.png", p_heat, width = 11, height = 7, dpi = 150)
print(p_heat)

# CLUSTERING MATRIX

likert_for_clustering <- likert_recoded[, colnames(likert_recoded) != "Q30"]
meta_for_clustering   <- meta[meta$Q_ID != "Q30", ]
 

# CORRELATION MATRIX
 
spearman_cor <- cor(
  likert_for_clustering,
  method = "spearman",
  use    = "pairwise.complete.obs"
)
 
na_cors <- sum(is.na(spearman_cor))
if (na_cors > 0) {
  print(which(is.na(spearman_cor), arr.ind = TRUE))
}
 
png("plot_correlation_matrix.png", width = 1200, height = 1100, res = 120)
corrplot(
  spearman_cor,
  method      = "color",
  type        = "upper",
  order       = "original",
  tl.col      = "black",
  tl.cex      = 0.7,
  cl.cex      = 0.7,
  addCoef.col = "black",
  number.cex  = 0.45,
  col         = colorRampPalette(c("#1a3a6b", "white", "#8b0000"))(200),
  title       = "Spearman Correlation Matrix (recoded, Q30 excluded)",
  mar         = c(0, 0, 2, 0)
)
 
group_sizes <- c(4, 4, 4, 4, 4, 4, 4, 3)
starts      <- cumsum(c(0, head(group_sizes, -1)))
n_q         <- ncol(likert_for_clustering)
for (i in seq_along(group_sizes)) {
  s <- starts[i]; e <- s + group_sizes[i]
  rect(s + 0.5, n_q - e + 0.5, e + 0.5, n_q - s + 0.5, border = "black", lwd = 2)
}
dev.off()
 

# HIERARCHICAL CLUSTERING FOR QUESTIONS
 
dist_questions <- as.dist(1 - abs(spearman_cor))
 
hc_ward    <- hclust(dist_questions, method = "ward.D2")
hc_average <- hclust(dist_questions, method = "average")
 
coph_ward    <- cor(dist_questions, cophenetic(hc_ward))
coph_average <- cor(dist_questions, cophenetic(hc_average))
 
principle_colors <- setNames(
  brewer.pal(8, "Set1"),
  c(
    "Respect for Human Agency",
    "Privacy and Data Governance",
    "Fairness",
    "Individual, Social & Environmental well-being",
    "Transparency",
    "Accountability & Oversight",
    "Worker Dignity & Equity",
    "Human Resilience Through Continuous Learning"
  )
)
 
label_colors <- principle_colors[meta_for_clustering$Principle]
names(label_colors) <- meta_for_clustering$Q_ID
 
plot_question_dendrogram <- function(hc, method_name, label_cols) {
  dend <- as.dendrogram(hc)
 
  png(paste0("plot_dendrogram_questions_", gsub(" ", "_", method_name), ".png"),
      width = 1400, height = 700, res = 120)
  par(mar = c(8, 4, 4, 2))
  plot(dend,
       main = paste0("Hierarchical Clustering of Questions (Q30 excluded), ", method_name),
       ylab = "Distance (1 - |Spearman r|)",
       cex.main = 1.1)
  dev.off()
}
 
plot_question_dendrogram(hc_ward,    "Ward's D2",       label_colors)
plot_question_dendrogram(hc_average, "Average Linkage", label_colors)
 

# HIERARCHICAL CLUSTERING FOR ETHICAL PRINCIPLES
 
spearman_principles <- cor(
  principle_scores,
  method = "spearman",
  use    = "pairwise.complete.obs"
)
 
print(round(spearman_principles, 2))
 
dist_principles <- as.dist(1 - abs(spearman_principles))
 
hc_prin_ward    <- hclust(dist_principles, method = "ward.D2")
hc_prin_average <- hclust(dist_principles, method = "average")
 
coph_prin_ward    <- cor(dist_principles, cophenetic(hc_prin_ward))
coph_prin_average <- cor(dist_principles, cophenetic(hc_prin_average))
 
principle_short_labels <- c(
  "Respect for Human Agency"                       = "Human Agency",
  "Privacy and Data Governance"                    = "Privacy & Data Gov.",
  "Fairness"                                       = "Fairness",
  "Individual, Social & Environmental well-being"  = "Well-Being",
  "Transparency"                                   = "Transparency",
  "Accountability & Oversight"                     = "Accountability",
  "Worker Dignity & Equity"                        = "Worker Dignity",
  "Human Resilience Through Continuous Learning"   = "Human Resilience"
)


 
plot_principle_dendrogram <- function(hc, method_name) {
  dend          <- as.dendrogram(hc)
  labels(dend)  <- principle_short_labels[labels(dend)]
  leaf_colors   <- brewer.pal(8, "Set1")
 
  png(paste0("plot_dendrogram_principles_", gsub(" ", "_", method_name), ".png"),
      width = 1000, height = 700, res = 150)
  par(mar = c(10, 4, 4, 2))
  plot(dend,
       main = paste0("Clustering of Ethical Principles, ", method_name),
       ylab = "Distance (1 - |Spearman r|)",
       cex.main = 1.1,
       cex      = 0.95)
  dev.off()
}
 
plot_principle_dendrogram(hc_prin_ward,    "Ward's D2")
plot_principle_dendrogram(hc_prin_average, "Average Linkage")
 

# HIERARCHICAL CLUSTERING FOR RESPONDENTS
 
dist_respondents <- dist(principle_scores, method = "euclidean")
 
hc_resp_ward    <- hclust(dist_respondents, method = "ward.D2")
hc_resp_average <- hclust(dist_respondents, method = "average")
 
coph_resp_ward    <- cor(dist_respondents, cophenetic(hc_resp_ward))
coph_resp_average <- cor(dist_respondents, cophenetic(hc_resp_average))
 
resp_labels <- paste0("R", 1:nrow(likert_recoded), ": ", job_short_map[job_titles])
 
plot_respondent_dendrogram <- function(hc, method_name, labels) {
  hc$labels <- labels
  dend      <- as.dendrogram(hc)
 
  png(paste0("plot_dendrogram_respondents_", gsub("[' ]", "_", method_name), ".png"),
      width = 1000, height = 700, res = 120)
  par(mar = c(12, 4, 4, 2))
  plot(dend,
       main     = paste0("Hierarchical Clustering of Respondents, ", method_name),
       ylab     = "Euclidean Distance",
       cex.axis = 0.9,
       cex.main = 1.1)
  dev.off()
}
 
plot_respondent_dendrogram(hc_resp_ward,    "Ward's D2",       resp_labels)
plot_respondent_dendrogram(hc_resp_average, "Average Linkage", resp_labels)


# CLUSTERED HEATMAP
 
short_prin_names <- c(
  "Respect for Human Agency"                       = "Human Agency",
  "Privacy and Data Governance"                    = "Privacy & Data Gov.",
  "Fairness"                                       = "Fairness",
  "Individual, Social & Environmental well-being"  = "Well-Being",
  "Transparency"                                   = "Transparency",
  "Accountability & Oversight"                     = "Accountability",
  "Worker Dignity & Equity"                        = "Worker Dignity",
  "Human Resilience Through Continuous Learning"   = "Human Resilience"
)
 
resp_order <- hc_resp_average$order
prin_order <- hc_prin_average$order
 
ps_clustered <- principle_scores[resp_order, prin_order]
rownames(ps_clustered) <- paste0("R", resp_order, ": ", job_titles[resp_order])
colnames(ps_clustered) <- short_prin_names[colnames(principle_scores)[prin_order]]
 
ps_clust_long <- as.data.frame(ps_clustered)
ps_clust_long$Respondent <- factor(rownames(ps_clustered),
                                    levels = rev(rownames(ps_clustered)))
ps_clust_melt <- melt(ps_clust_long,
                      id.vars       = "Respondent",
                      variable.name = "Principle",
                      value.name    = "Score")
ps_clust_melt$Principle <- factor(ps_clust_melt$Principle,
                                   levels = colnames(ps_clustered))
 
p_clust_heat <- ggplot(ps_clust_melt,
                       aes(x = Principle, y = Respondent, fill = Score)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(Score, 1)), size = 2.8,
            color = "white", fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "plasma", direction = -1, limits = c(1, 6)) +
  labs(
    title    = "Clustered Heatmap: Respondents and Ethical Principles",
    subtitle = "Rows and columns reordered by average linkage cluster solution",
    x        = "Ethical Principle (clustered)",
    y        = "Respondent (clustered)",
    fill     = "Score"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x  = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1, size = 9),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 8),
    plot.title   = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid   = element_blank()
  )
 
ggsave("plot_clustered_heatmap.png", p_clust_heat, width = 11, height = 7, dpi = 150)
print(p_clust_heat)

# PARALLEL COORDINATES PLOT

k_respondents <- 2
resp_clusters <- cutree(hc_resp_average, k = k_respondents)

for (i in 1:k_respondents) {
  members <- which(resp_clusters == i)
}
 
pc_data            <- principle_scores
pc_data$Respondent <- paste0("R", 1:nrow(pc_data), ": ", job_titles)
pc_data$Cluster    <- factor(paste("Cluster", resp_clusters[1:nrow(pc_data)]))
colnames(pc_data)[1:8] <- unname(short_prin_names[colnames(pc_data)[1:8]])
 
pc_long <- melt(pc_data,
                id.vars       = c("Respondent", "Cluster"),
                variable.name = "Principle",
                value.name    = "Score")
pc_long$Principle <- factor(pc_long$Principle,
                             levels = colnames(ps_clustered))
 
cluster_colors <- brewer.pal(max(k_respondents, 3), "Set2")[1:k_respondents]
 
p_parallel <- ggplot(pc_long,
                     aes(x = Principle, y = Score,
                         group = Respondent, color = Cluster)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5, alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cluster_colors) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(1, 6), breaks = 1:6) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 3.5, linetype = "dashed",
             color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.5) +
  labs(
    title    = "Respondent Ethical Profiles",
    subtitle = "Each line represent one respondent",
    x        = "Ethical Principle",
    y        = "Score (1-6, recoded)",
    color    = "Cluster"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x     = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1, size = 9),
    plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right"
  )
 
ggsave("plot_parallel_coordinates.png", p_parallel, width = 12, height = 6, dpi = 150)
print(p_parallel)

```


```{r}
# ELBOW METHOD FOR RESPONDENTS

max_k <- nrow(principle_scores) - 1

wss <- numeric(max_k)

for (k in 1:max_k) {
  clusters <- cutree(hc_resp_average, k = k)
  
  wss[k] <- sum(sapply(1:k, function(cluster) {
    members <- principle_scores[clusters == cluster, ]
    if (is.data.frame(members) && nrow(members) > 1) {
      centroid <- colMeans(members)
      sum(apply(members, 1, function(x) sum((x - centroid)^2)))
    } else {
      0
    }
  }))
}

elbow_data <- data.frame(
  k   = 1:max_k,
  WSS = wss
)

print(elbow_data)

elbow_data$WSS_drop    <- c(NA, diff(elbow_data$WSS) * -1)
elbow_data$WSS_drop_pct <- c(NA, round(elbow_data$WSS_drop[2:max_k] / elbow_data$WSS[1:(max_k-1)] * 100, 1))

print(elbow_data)

p_elbow <- ggplot(elbow_data, aes(x = k, y = WSS)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1, color = "steelblue") +
  geom_point(size = 3, color = "steelblue") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:max_k) +
  labs(
    title    = "Elbow Method, Optimal Number of Respondent Clusters",
    x        = "Number of Clusters (k)",
    y        = "Within-Cluster Sum of Squares (WSS)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))

ggsave("plot_elbow_respondents.png", p_elbow, width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 150)
print(p_elbow)
```

```{r}
# ELBOW METHOD FOR ETHICAL PRINCIPLES

max_k_prin <- ncol(principle_scores) - 1

wss_prin <- numeric(max_k_prin)

for (k in 1:max_k_prin) {
  clusters <- cutree(hc_prin_average, k = k)
  
  wss_prin[k] <- sum(sapply(1:k, function(cluster) {

    members <- t(principle_scores)[clusters == cluster, , drop = FALSE]
    if (nrow(members) > 1) {
      centroid <- colMeans(members)
      sum(apply(members, 1, function(x) sum((x - centroid)^2)))
    } else {
      0
    }
  }))
}

elbow_prin_data <- data.frame(
  k   = 1:max_k_prin,
  WSS = wss_prin
)

elbow_prin_data$WSS_drop     <- c(NA, -diff(elbow_prin_data$WSS))
elbow_prin_data$WSS_drop_pct <- c(NA, round(
  elbow_prin_data$WSS_drop[2:max_k_prin] / 
  elbow_prin_data$WSS[1:(max_k_prin - 1)] * 100, 1))

print(elbow_prin_data)

p_elbow_prin <- ggplot(elbow_prin_data, aes(x = k, y = WSS)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1, color = "steelblue") +
  geom_point(size = 3, color = "steelblue") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:max_k_prin) +
  labs(
    title    = "Optimal Number of Principle Clusters",
    x        = "Number of Clusters (k)",
    y        = "Within-Cluster Sum of Squares (WSS)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))

ggsave("plot_elbow_principles.png", p_elbow_prin, width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 150)
print(p_elbow_prin)
```

```{r}
# ELBOW METHOD AND LARGEST GAP CRITERION FOR ITEM LEVEL DENDROGRAM
library(cluster)

max_k_items <- ncol(likert_for_clustering) - 1

wss_items <- numeric(max_k_items)

for (k in 1:max_k_items) {
  clusters <- cutree(hc_average, k = k)
  
  wss_items[k] <- sum(sapply(1:k, function(cluster) {
    members <- t(likert_for_clustering)[clusters == cluster, , drop = FALSE]
    if (nrow(members) > 1) {
      centroid <- colMeans(members)
      sum(apply(members, 1, function(x) sum((x - centroid)^2)))
    } else {
      0
    }
  }))
}

elbow_items_data <- data.frame(
  k   = 1:max_k_items,
  WSS = wss_items
)

elbow_items_data$WSS_drop     <- c(NA, -diff(elbow_items_data$WSS))
elbow_items_data$WSS_drop_pct <- c(NA, round(
  elbow_items_data$WSS_drop[2:max_k_items] /
  elbow_items_data$WSS[1:(max_k_items - 1)] * 100, 1))

print(elbow_items_data)

p_elbow_items <- ggplot(elbow_items_data, aes(x = k, y = WSS)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1, color = "steelblue") +
  geom_point(size = 2.5, color = "steelblue") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(1, max_k_items, by = 2)) +
  labs(
    title    = "Optimal Number of Item Clusters",
    x        = "Number of Clusters (k)",
    y        = "Within-Cluster Sum of Squares (WSS)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))

ggsave("plot_elbow_items.png", p_elbow_items, width = 9, height = 5, dpi = 150)
print(p_elbow_items)

heights_items <- hc_average$height

gaps_items <- data.frame(

  Height_upper = round(heights_items[2:length(heights_items)], 4),

)

gaps_items$k_clusters <- length(heights_items) + 1 - gaps_items$Merge_step

print(gaps_items[order(-gaps_items$Gap), ], row.names = FALSE)

largest_gap_items <- gaps_items[which.max(gaps_items$Gap), ]

cut_height_items <- mean(c(largest_gap_items$Height_lower,
                            largest_gap_items$Height_upper))

item_labels <- paste0(
  meta_for_clustering$Q_ID, " (",
  gsub("Respect for Human Agency",                      "Agency",
  gsub("Privacy and Data Governance",                   "Privacy",
  gsub("Fairness",                                      "Fairness",
  gsub("Individual, Social & Environmental well-being", "Well-Being",
  gsub("Transparency",                                  "Transparency",
  gsub("Accountability & Oversight",                    "Account.",
  gsub("Worker Dignity & Equity",                       "Worker Dig.",
  gsub("Human Resilience Through Continuous Learning",  "Resilience",
  meta_for_clustering$Principle)))))))),
  ")"
)
names(item_labels) <- meta_for_clustering$Q_ID

png("plot_dendrogram_items_gap.png", width = 1600, height = 800, res = 130)
par(mar = c(12, 4, 4, 2))

dend_items <- as.dendrogram(hc_average)
labels(dend_items) <- item_labels[labels(dend_items)]

plot(dend_items,
     main     = "Hierarchical Clustering of Items, Average Linkage",
     ylab     = "Distance (1 - |Spearman r|)",

abline(h = cut_height_items, col = "red", lty = 2, lwd = 2)
text(x = 2, y = cut_height_items + 0.02,
```

```{r}
# SILHOUETTE CUTS


library(cluster)

optimal_k_prin <- 2
clusters_prin  <- cutree(hc_prin_average, k = optimal_k_prin)

prin_cluster_table <- data.frame(
  Principle = names(clusters_prin),
  Cluster   = clusters_prin
)
prin_cluster_table <- prin_cluster_table[order(prin_cluster_table$Cluster), ]

print(prin_cluster_table, row.names = FALSE)

for (cl in sort(unique(prin_cluster_table$Cluster))) {
  members <- prin_cluster_table$Principle[prin_cluster_table$Cluster == cl]
  for (m in members) cat(sprintf("  - %s\n", m))
}

heights_prin   <- sort(hc_prin_average$height)
n_prin         <- length(heights_prin)
cut_height_prin_k3 <- mean(c(heights_prin[n_prin - optimal_k_prin + 1],
                               heights_prin[n_prin - optimal_k_prin + 2]))

     main   = "Silhouette Plot, Ethical Principles (k=2)",

     col    = brewer.pal(3, "Set2"))

text(x = 1, y = cut_height_prin_k3 + 0.02,
     labels = paste0("Cut = ", round(cut_height_prin_k3, 3), "  (k = 3)"),
     col = "red", cex = 0.8, adj = 0)

dev.off()

max_k_resp <- nrow(principle_scores) - 1
sil_widths_resp <- numeric(max_k_resp - 1)

for (k in 2:max_k_resp) {
  clusters         <- cutree(hc_resp_average, k = k)
  sil              <- silhouette(clusters, dist_respondents)
  sil_widths_resp[k - 1] <- mean(sil[, 3])
}

sil_resp_data <- data.frame(

clusters_resp <- cutree(hc_resp_average, k = optimal_k_resp)

}
```
